fields.headline: Adds $1M to Leading Educators' literacy contract, raising its total cap to $1.31M
fields.summary: Leading Educators, Inc. of New Orleans helps the district reach its revised English language literacy goals and milestones under the Schusterman Family Foundation grant (2021-2023). This change adds $1,000,000, raising the agreement's not-to-exceed total for the whole term from $306,609 to $1,306,609. The attachment splits the added money $500,000 for 2021-22 and $500,000 for 2022-23, paid from the grant. The agreement period runs October 1, 2020 through September 29, 2023.

22-0767.sourceIssue: The text describes the $1,000,000 as raising the agreement's 'year 1' amount from $306,609.00 to $1,306,609.00, but the attached agreement and amendment show these are the not-to-exceed amounts for the whole October 2020 to September 2023 term.
